description: This file defines the SessionHandler class that implements PHP's SessionHandlerInterface to store sessions in Amazon DynamoDB. It manages session lifecycle operations such as open, close, read, write, destroy, and garbage collection, interfacing with DynamoDB through connection objects. The class supports configuration options like locking, session lifetime, and table schema details.

classes.name: SessionHandler
classes.description: Implements PHP's SessionHandlerInterface to store PHP sessions in Amazon DynamoDB, managing session lifecycle operations and providing configuration options such as locking and expiration.

methods.name: fromClient
methods.description: Factory method to create a SessionHandler instance configured with a DynamoDbClient and options, optionally enabling locking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SessionHandler with a connection object implementing SessionConnectionInterface.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers this Handler as the PHP session handler.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes session storage with provided save path and session name.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the session, ensuring it is unlocked and expiration updated.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data by ID from DynamoDB, handling expiration and possible deletion.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores session data in DynamoDB, tracking changes.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Stub for garbage collection; actual cleanup is manual via garbageCollect().

methods.name: garbageCollect
methods.description: Triggers removal of expired sessions from DynamoDB.

methods.name: formatId
methods.description: Prepares session ID with session name prefix for storage.
